line: Lenovo Yoga 9i 2-in-1 Aura Edition (14", Gen 10, Lunar Lake)
config_name: Yoga 9i 2-in-1 Aura Edition 14" — Core Ultra 7 258V, 32GB LPDDR5x, 1TB SSD, 2.8K OLED 120Hz touch

specs.display_type: OLED touch, glossy, HDR, rotating soundbar hinge
specs.speakers: Bowers & Wilkins rotating soundbar (2 woofers + 2 tweeters)
specs.keyboard_notes: Backlit chiclet, glass trackpad; Yoga Pen included (MPP 2.0, charges in chassis)

battery.notes: 70Wh, Lunar Lake; same as 16GB twin (on-package RAM has no battery penalty).

price.notes: 32GB Lunar Lake tier sold at Lenovo CA launch; not at BBY (they moved to Gen 11). lenovo.com/ca PDP is a JS shell — price estimated (+~$400 over 16GB twin).

reviews.quote: High-quality & stable case, improved battery life, good system performance, OLED with high 4K resolution, Thunderbolt 4 & Wi-Fi 7, stylus attaches to case magnetically. Cons: RAM can't be upgraded, PWM flickering, OLED only at 60 Hz and without color profiles, neither HDMI nor an SD card reader. ("The high-end convertible suffers due to weak 4K OLED" — NBC review of the Yoga 9 14 2-in-1 Gen 10 Lunar Lake.)

praises: 32GB means heavy multitasking plus local Copilot+ AI features without the 16GB ceiling worry
Rotating soundbar hinge speakers are the best-sounding laptop speakers in this class
2.8K OLED at 120Hz with inky blacks; video and photo work look superb
Active pen included in the box (charges in the chassis slot)
Lunar Lake battery easily lasts a full workday of light use
complaints: RAM is on-package — you must buy 32GB up front (the 16GB tier can't be upgraded later, which is what pushes buyers here and inflates the price)
OLED moire/graininess on small black-on-white text is visible to sensitive users
USB-C-only ports (2x TB4) — dongle life without a dock
Glossy OLED reflects overhead lights outdoors
Fan noise and performance drop under sustained load despite 32GB

design_philosophy: Lenovo's Yoga 9i is the convertible flagship: a machined-aluminium 360° 2-in-1 whose signature is the rotating soundbar hinge keeping Bowers & Wilkins speakers aimed at you in every mode. The Aura Edition generation leans into thinness, Copilot+ AI silicon, and pen-first creativity. This 32GB tier is the multitasker's pick of the Gen 10 line — since Lunar Lake RAM is on-package and non-upgradeable, the 32GB config is the future-proof choice buyers pay a premium for.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the Yoga 9 14 2-in-1 G10 Aura Edition (89%, gap-fill 2026-11-24). Ratings inferred from SHARED-yoga9i.md anchor (NBC 90.5%, Gen 9 14IMH9 chassis twin) with Lunar Lake deltas; this config is the 16GB/1TB sibling + 16GB RAM: productivity +0.5, ai_ml +0.5 (more headroom for local LLMs on 47 TOPS NPU + Arc 140V). No direct review of this tier found; CA price estimated (not at BBY).
